title: Florida House, District 46
what_it_does: Represents District 46 (Part of Osceola) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Michael Cruz
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Real estate professional; U.S. Army veteran
candidates.background: Cruz served in the U.S. Army from 1979 to 1986, attended Caribbean University in Bayamon, Puerto Rico, and works in real estate. He was the 2024 Republican nominee in HD 46, losing to Alvarez, and is running again in 2026.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

candidates.name: Jose Alvarez
candidates.occupation: Real estate broker and business consultant; state representative (elected 2024)
candidates.background: Alvarez, 62, moved to Florida in 1974 and lives in Kissimmee, where he served on the city commission from 2012 and as mayor from 2016 to 2020. A former HUD regional administrator and past president of the Osceola County Association of Realtors, he was elected to the House in 2024.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Voted against both HJR 203 and HJR 1F and says he will vote no on Amendment 3 because it would hit counties, cities, schools and renters.
property_tax.quote: It sounds like a savings, but someone has to pay for a lot of our essential services

housing.summary: Backs public-private partnerships, targeted tax credits and streamlined permitting for workforce housing.
